description: Large batteries for electricity storage is a dataset listed in Dutch national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by CBS OpenData. This table contains figures about batteries for electricity storage with a storage capacity 1 MWh. This concerns the number of systems, storage capacity and power, with the end of the reporting year as the reference date. It also concerns gross production, own use and the input of electricity over the entire reporting year. Coverage: the Netherlands. The portal files it under the publisher CBS OpenData. It offers 2 resource(s) in HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/ATOM, HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/JSON. The portal shows 2026-06-16 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-nl-portal.
